title: execute or deny controlled canary activation through AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine gates

files.role: controlled canary activation gate evaluation and denial projection script
controlled activation handoff for rollback drill

criteria: The projection script consumes RC10-010 publication denial, RC10-011 drift-zero denial, RC10-012 fetch denial, RC10-020 target enrollment denial, and RC10-021 execution binding denial before evaluating activation.
The activation gate report records activation-denied with activation_allowed=false and activation_performed=false.

The activation denial evidence covers publication, external URI, drift-zero, quarantine fetch, target enrollment, exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine, remote dispatch, and controlled execution authorization blockers.
The controlled activation handoff moves the workflow to RC10-030 while rollback execution remains denied.
The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and does not mutate install, activation, rollback, active slot, boot metadata, production ring, support upload, or remote dispatch state.
